translations.web: The king made silver as common as stones in Jerusalem, and cedars as common as the sycamore trees that are in the lowland.
translations.bsb: The king made silver as common in Jerusalem as stones, and cedar as abundant as sycamore in the foothills.
translations.kjv: And the king made silver to be in Jerusalem as stones, and cedars made he to be as the sycomore trees that are in the vale, for abundance.
translations.asv: And the king made silver to be in Jerusalem as stones, and cedars made he to be as the sycomore-trees that are in the lowland, for abundance.
